title: Real Estate Video Tour | 5905 Chelsea Cove N Hopewell Junction, NY 12533 | Dutchess County, NY
description:
More Info: http://hometours.hometourvision.com/68107/

It's not just a home, it's a lifestyle! Completely remodeled, this 3 bedroom, 2 bath, tri-level townhome in the beautiful Chelsea Cove community is loaded w/ upgrades & move-in ready. Enter the home to find an open concept living & dining area w/ Pellet Stove & double sliding glass doors to the new expanded deck – perfect for entertaining! The kitchen & baths have been remodeled w/ custom cabinets & granite counters. Upstairs you'll find a generous master bedroom w/ 2 additional bedrooms. The lower level features a built in bar area, family rm w/ sliding doors out to a patio & huge storage room. Outside, the Chelsea Cove community offers lake access to Sylvan Lake w/ its own private beach, boat launch access, & storage of small boats & kayaks right at the lake. Take a stroll on the private walking trail along the lake or stop & gaze at the beautiful serene ponds. Basketball & tennis courts complete the picture. All of this w/ easy access.
